integrity: Exact symbolic proof and a separate finite checker; prior-art search found no directly covering statement, but does not establish absolute historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Infinitesimal planet and fixed geometry; positive radial intensity with polynomial-plus-mu^(3/2) structure; full-disk area-weighted intensity least-squares quadratic fit with floating normalization; no claims for noisy or finite-radius transits, different weights, or observational robustness.
title: Three universal transit-depth cancellation chords for a nonquadratic stellar limb profile
